verdict.rationale: Scoping a remote session to view-only, control, clipboard or file access is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents session permission controls of this kind. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: organization-level user roles and permissions, and Customer and Service modules that only receive or only initiate connections.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
